svg.aria-label: MovieRecom — ESIEE Paris · pair project. An “evening advisor”: instead of scrolling through a catalogue, you describe what you feel like and a local LLM negotiates with you on the film to watch. Stack: Helidon SE, jOOQ, SQLite, Svelte, Qwen2.5-7B.
